# MDL109 · `unparsable-line`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

GLib rejects a line for a reason no more specific rule describes.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | loading |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |
| Flags | unsuppressible |
| Design references | §6.2 |

## Why

mydumper-lint emulates GLib exactly, so every line GLib would reject is reported. This rule is the safety net for a rejection that none of MDL101–MDL111 explains; please report it as a bug with the file so a specific rule can be added.

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL109: warning   # or error, info, off
```

Its diagnostics mean mydumper ignores the whole file: they cannot be suppressed by comments, only by the configuration or `--ignore`.
